notebook: PLAN: Step 1 test a full blend-oriented train; Step 2 sharpen every natural cut enough to reach 95%, inspect economics, then prune/tune; Step 3 test premium purification or side draws. note: Correct the root material balance, add an ethane/C3 splitter, and sharpen the remaining natural blend and heavy-product cuts.
notebook: PLAN: Step 1 test full blend train; Step 2 make all natural cuts sellable and establish economics; Step 3 prune/tune and test premium only if cheap. On Step 2. notebook: PLAN: Step 1 test full blend train; Step 2 make all natural cuts sellable and establish economics; Step 3 prune/tune and test premium only if cheap. In the heavy train, BB should place all heptane with naphthenes: add BBT for the valuable C6-naphthene blend and heptane, and use BBB directly for octane/nonane, deleting BBBB. Potential sale value is over $3bn/yr, so temporarily accept higher column costs to establish clean cuts.

note: Prune every zero-value downstream branch and sharpen only the root and C6 splitter, aiming to unlock the C6-paraffin blend while cutting column count from eight to four.
notebook: PLAN: Step 1 test full blend train; Step 2 make natural cuts sellable; Step 3 prune dead branches and tune the profitable backbone; Step 4 test premium only if cheap. On Step 3. note: Reduce capital and energy across the profitable backbone, using the purity margin in the C6 cut while retaining the saleable C5 and premium n-butane products.
